description: Economy validation grid (PLAN-metalstorm-economy.md §4): batch matrix for tuning ceiling/decay and reward normalisation constants. Runs over {2,4,8} players/side × {sparse,normal,dense} objective density × {aggressive,default,turtle} AI profiles × 4 seeds, simulated 2 weeks each.
comment: This is a config TEMPLATE — the batch driver (tools/headless-batch/) expands it into N individual configs by iterating the matrix variables. Each cell is one headless run.
comment_map_rebind: map/scenario rebound 2026-08-06 by the metalstorm-scenario-maps lane. `meridian_basin_beta` (PLAN-economy-grid.md defect B2) was never a real map id — it was the working name for the beta map that shipped as `meridian_basin`. That map is itself unplayable: its start positions sit in three disconnected components of the VEH/HEAVY passability mask, so armour cannot reach its own victory objective (PLAN-metalstorm-wars.md §7.6). PLAN-economy-grid.md §3's decision to 'run the existing meridian_basin.lua scenario' is therefore void — that scenario is retired. The grid now targets the replacement showcase war. The economy lane still owns whether this map's 7168-elmo square and 16-region graph suit its matrix; this rebind only removes the dangling reference.

baseConfig.comment_slots: Slots are generated from matrix variables — see batch driver

stopAt.comment: 2 weeks simulated time = 14 days × 24 h/day × 60 min/h × 60 s/min × 30 frames/s

headless.comment_hash: Every 30 minutes sim time for determinism checks

acceptance.comment: Criteria from PLAN-metalstorm-economy.md §4. A run passes if ALL conditions hold. The grid passes if ≥90% of runs pass.
acceptance.comment_dead_time: Dead-team time < 1% of runtime (excluding end-game — defined as final 10% of frames)
acceptance.comment_join_grant: Churn-amplified runs: join grants < 10% of total mint (the grant-inflation check)
